'''Luran Gonthor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a legitimate businessman in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. When his workshop was taken by the Justicars, he couldn't prove ownership of the workshop without the deed, which was locked away deep inside the business. He tasked a Republic individual to travel to his workshop and in Justicar Territory and retrieve the deed.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Luran appears in the mission "Trouble in Deed" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
